description:
From Harbor Area, Ca Mango Hill is proud to bring you the long long awaited 7" by Soul Wonder Trish Toledo!
Toledo a devoted fan of music has built her whole fan base on serenading her audience with soul classics and has earned herself a devoted fan base in return. As the world has been waiting she delivered this spring with her debut single "Thee Only One" with a little help from Joey Quiñones and East Los Angeles's Thee Sinseers
